build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c "npm run prepare-sidecar && npm run dev"
build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c "npm run prepare-sidecar && npm run build"

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:1420; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'
